scripts.services:start: redis-cli ping >/dev/null 2>&1 || redis-server --daemonize yes --maxmemory-policy noeviction --port 6379; mongosh --quiet --eval 'db.runCommand({ ping: 1 })' >/dev/null 2>&1 || (mkdir -p ~/.mongodb/data && GLIBC_TUNABLES='glibc.pthread.rseq=1' mongod --dbpath ~/.mongodb/data --fork --logpath ~/.mongodb/mongod.log)
scripts.services:stop: redis-cli shutdown 2>/dev/null || true; mongosh --eval "db.adminCommand({ shutdown: 1 })" 2>/dev/null || true
